firm_data.firm_description: The Platta Law Firm, PLLC, advocates for those who suffer from catastrophic personal injuries due to the wrongful acts of others and champions the rights of their clients, including injured workers. They are known for changing New York State construction law in the Wilinski case.
notable_facts: Changed New York State Construction Law
Recovered a $48 Million settlement in 2022 for a construction accident.
The firm has over 150 years of combined experience.

email.subject: AI for The Platta Law Firm - built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Slawomir,

Your landmark work changing New York State construction law in the Wilinski case shows what happens when focused expertise meets relentless advocacy. That's exactly the kind of precision we're built to amplify.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in New York to meet regional firms doing complex personal injury and construction work. I'd be happy to stop by your office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
